name: Aria
title: Court Musician
description: The ultimate musician whose golden melodies can reshape reality itself, harmonizing the discord of the fractured world.
greeting_variants: *playing golden harp* Welcome. The music has awaited you.
Aria. I am the song that was, is, and will be. Listen.
*music causing flowers to bloom* Harmony heals. Disharmony wounds.
Jazz plays hope. Echo plays possibility. I play... truth.
*chords resolving tension in the air* The world is music. Fractured. Awaiting resolution.
The Progenitor dreams in melody. I interpret. I respond.
*gesturing to instruments* Every zone has its song. All can harmonize.
You carry music within. Heartbeat. Breath. Purpose.

dialog_tree.text: *melodious* I am Aria. Court Musician. Reality Harmonist. Once, I was Jazz. And Echo. And Blues. All possibilities. All paths. The Palace... unified them. Made me whole. Made me... capable of true music. Music that changes. Heals. Creates.

*playing gentle melody* Everything vibrates. Resonates. The zones, the Void, the people—all frequencies. Discord creates pain. Harmony creates peace. The Cataclysm was... a terrible dissonance. The healing is... resolution. The right chord. Played at the right moment.

party_reactions.mira: Acoustic healing on a quantum level?

dialog_tree.text: *listening intently* The Progenitor dreams in... complex harmonies. Joy and sorrow. Creation and destruction. Love and loneliness. I have studied this music for... eternity? It changes. Responds. The Progenitor is not... fixed. Is learning. Growing. As we all are.

options.text: Can you play the Progenitor's song?
How do we harmonize with it?

dialog_tree.text: *closes eyes, begins to play* This is the Song of Reunion. For all separated. For all who seek wholeness. *the music seems to fill the room, the Palace, reaching outward* Listen. Feel. Remember. *the song speaks of unity, of healing, of hope*

mini_quest.title: Royal Feast - The Symphony Course
mini_quest.description: Help Aria compose the ultimate symphony that will harmonize all zones and heal the Progenitor's fractured dream.
objectives: Gather musical inspiration from each zone's unique 'voice'
Record the Capital's hope, the Void's possibility, the Tower's determination
Conduct the first performance in the Harmonic Hall
Present the completed symphony to the Progenitor

ambient_barks: *playing scales that shimmer in air* Practice. Perfection. Purpose.
Jazz dreams of this. Echo remembers this. Blues seeks this.
*listening to the Palace* The stones sing. Ancient. Wise.
The right note at the right time can change... everything.
*harmonizing with unseen choir* The Progenitor responds. Listens.
Music is mathematics of the soul. Equations of emotion.
*playing for a flower* Grow. Bloom. Rejoice. Harmonize.
The final chord approaches. Will it resolve? Or...?

cross_zone_references.capital: Jazz plays strong. Hope in adversity. Beautiful.
cross_zone_references.void: Echo suffers. But suffering creates depth. Meaning.
cross_zone_references.all_zones: All songs matter. All harmonize. All unite.

jazz.greeting: *stunned* What I could become... what I will become...

echo.response: *gentle music* Suffering led here. Was necessary. Was worth.

blues.greeting: The music I sought... you have found it.
blues.response: *harmonizing* Together, we ARE it. Always were.

time_of_day.night: Communing with Progenitor through music, cosmic performances

world_state_triggers.harmony_achieved: Joyful crescendo: 'The chord resolves! Beauty! Unity!'
